name: Shakaraim
title: Benjamite patriarch in Moab
summary: Shakaraim was a man from the tribe of Benjamin who sent away his two wives, Hushim and Baara, to the land of Moab. He then had children with his wife Hodesh, and his descendants became family heads in Benjamin. He is known from the genealogies in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Shaharaim Sends Away His Wives
keyEvents.description: Shaharaim sent away his wives Hushim and Baara while he was living in the land of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Children with Hodish
keyEvents.description: With his wife Hodish, Shaharaim had sons Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sakia, and Mirmah. These became heads of families.

keyEvents.title: Descendants through Hushim
keyEvents.description: Shaharaim also had sons Abitub and Elpaal with Hushim before he sent her away.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Elpaal
keyEvents.description: Shaharaim's son Elpaal became the ancestor of a significant clan among the Benjamites, including those who built Ono and Lod.
